svg.title: 010 fog comparison / 27 June responders
svg.desc: Fog treatments are columns, best-ranked first. Each labeled row shares one fixture and viewpoint. Half-resolution ground rasters. Story revelations through page 039.
svg.text: FOG-OF-WAR STUDIES — NOT ADOPTED / COLUMNS W3, W2, W1 / OPEN AT FULL SIZE / REVELATIONS THROUGH 039

svg.title: Patchy contest — 010 / Before the boundary is named — 27 June responders
svg.desc: Fog of war, Patchy contest: 010 / Before the boundary is named, 27 June responders. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 dark; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 dark. P1 outer foothold hatched. Observation islands: response lit, correction dark, configuration dark, weights dark. P6 is only an unnamed dark hint. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted. Shaded relief with a soft, irregular fog edge; unexplored ground is opaque, ground that lost support stays dimly visible. Many pictograms lie draped on the ground beneath the fog, not text; a key names them outside the map.
svg.text: SYMBOLS LIE ON THE GROUND, UNDER THE FOG
THE ALERT, BOARD AND PIVOT DO NOT DISCLOSE THE WHOLE EVENT.
010.3–4 / disputed scorer accounts; design / fixed response boundary · OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC RELIEF / FOG IS COMPUTED, NOT MEASURED
